metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully hid GIMP docks by navigating Windows menu and clicking Hide Docks in 3 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate GIMP menus (Windows menu), toggle UI visibility settings, understands dock/tab/window concepts.
metadata.task_rationale: Successful trajectory showed the agent can toggle GIMP UI settings via Windows menu. This variation targets window mode switching, a different but related setting accessible from the same menu.
metadata.explanation: Task requires switching GIMP from single-window to multi-window mode via Windows > Single-Window Mode (uncheck). Evaluator checks sessionrc for single-window-mode=no after quitting GIMP.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads GIMP sessionrc config file which stores the single-window-mode setting.
Metric check_config_status correctly parses sessionrc lines and checks if key 'single-window-mode' has value 'no', which correctly verifies multi-window mode is enabled.
Postconfig correctly quits GIMP with Ctrl+Q before reading sessionrc, since GIMP writes session config on exit.
Complete coverage: the single instruction requirement (switch to multi-window mode) is fully verified by checking the config key.
Minor cosmetic issue: rules dict has 'type:' (with trailing colon) instead of 'type', but this key is unused by check_config_status so no runtime impact.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Fix typo in rules: change 'type:' to 'type' (cosmetic, no functional impact).
